reason: Delivery importance decides it: C17 has 37 major episodes (P95) against C15's 21 (P47), and his majors include durable, completed company-wide changes such as the CSP program that took the app from report-only to enforced (#106238, #116719), the single access-precedence resolver (#114423, deep-read P=16), and the three-day eMudhra CA root removal across every shipped runtime (#121580, #122294). C15 has the higher volume-weighted delivery (690.6 vs 527.5) and far stronger team leverage (889.5, P58 vs 350.3, P5; trust_rank P84 vs P16), and his OAuth/MCP fixes (#113013, #105547) are critical, but his largest new platform, the hog CLI (ws5), has not yet replaced posthog-cli, so part of his impact is still prospective. Both carry quality caveats (C17's ~24 CSP repair PRs vs C15's 7 follow-up fixes, quality_rate 0.945 at P10, and review concentrated on one approver), so neither red flag offsets C17's lead in completed, high-criticality delivery.
